title: EU Directive 2024/1799 (Empowering Consumers for the Green Transition - ECGT)

sections.legal_context: EU Directive 2024/1799 amends Directives 2005/29/EC (Unfair Commercial Practices Directive) and 2011/83/EU (Consumer Rights Directive) to empower consumers for the green transition. It establishes strict rules against generic greenwashing, climate-neutral claims based on offsetting, and misleading sustainability labels while introducing mandatory disclosures for durability and repairability.

obligations.text: Prohibition of making generic environmental claims ('eco-friendly', 'green', 'climate positive', 'environmentally sound') unless based on recognized official eco-labels or clear verification.
obligations.notes: Applies to listing titles, descriptions, and custom item attributes on EU sites.

obligations.text: Prohibition of claims that a product has a neutral, reduced, or positive impact on the environment based on greenhouse gas emissions offsetting.
obligations.notes: Product-level carbon offset claims strictly prohibited regardless of offset quality.

obligations.text: Mandatory display of Harmonised Label and Harmonised Notice regarding commercial guarantees of durability provided by producers without extra cost for more than 2 years.
obligations.notes: Harmonised EU badge visual token + text mandatory.

obligations.text: Mandatory disclosure of Repairability Index score (1.0 to 10.0 scale) or availability of spare parts for energy-related products.
obligations.notes: Applies to smartphones, laptops, TVs, washing machines, and appliances.

obligations.text: Mandatory disclosure of minimum period during which software updates will be made available for products with digital elements.
obligations.notes: Required for smart home devices, wearables, and computing hardware.

sections.ebay_applicability: Applies to all C2C and B2C listings on EU eBay sites (DE, FR, IT, ES, IE, NL, PL, AT) displaying environmental claims, eco-labels, durability claims, or selling electronics and appliances.
sections.exemptions: C2C private seller transactions are exempt from mandatory durability notices unless commercial seller status thresholds are triggered.

open_legal_questions.question: Does seller cross-border listing from UK to DE trigger mandatory Article 4(3) repairability disclosures?
open_legal_questions.resolution: Yes, destination-based enforcement applies if shipping to EU consumer destination.
